requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall provide user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years to ensure accountability and compliance.
The system shall provide mechanisms to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall support functionalities for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall implement energy-efficient logging mechanisms that align with audit trails to minimize energy consumption.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
